params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Ryze}} gains {{sti|mana|{{as|'''maximum''' mana}}}} based on his {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ryze''' increases his {{as|{{sti|mana|'''maximum''' mana}}}} by {{as|(10% per 100 AP)}}.
params.notes:
* Any increase in maximum mana is treated as bonus mana.
* With {{ii|Rabadon's Deathcap}}, a total of {{as|{{#expr: {{cid|Rabadon's Deathcap|ap}} * 1.3 / 10 round 1 }}% ({{as|10% AP|AP}}) '''maximum''' mana|mana}} is gained.
* ''Arcane Mastery'' together with {{ii|Archangel's Staff}} or {{ii|Seraph's Embrace}} creates a [[Recursion|recursive stat loop]]: {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} giving {{as|{{sti|mana}}}} and so on. 
*Another way to create a [[Recursion|recursive stat loop]], is to have any converter of {{as|{{sti|mana}}}} to {{as|{{sti|health}}}} ({{ii|Winter's Approach}}, {{ii|Fimbulwinter}} or the [[Ultra_Rapid_Fire#Features|U.R.F. buff]]) and {{ii|Riftmaker}}. The first converter giving {{as|{{sti|mana}}}} to {{as|{{sti|health}}}}, {{ii|Riftmaker}} giving {{as|{{sti|health}}}} to {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} and ''Arcane Mastery'' giving {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} to {{as|{{sti|mana}}}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Ryze gains maximum mana based on his ability power.

description.plain: Innate: Ryze increases his maximum mana by (10% per 100 AP).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Ryze}} other {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts {{sti|ah|reset}} ''Overload's'' cooldown and generate a ''{{ai|Overload 3|Ryze|Rune}}'' stack, stacking up to 2 times.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' unleashes a runic bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and consumes all ''{{ai|Overload 4|Ryze|Rune}}'' stacks.
params.blurb3: If '''Ryze''' consumes the maximum ''{{ai|Overload 4|Ryze|Rune}}'' stacks, he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}  for a short time.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} ''Overload'' deals increased damage and spreads to surrounding ''Flux'' enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ryze's''' other {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts reset ''Overload's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and charge a [[File:Overload 3.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' {{tip|stack}} for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 2 times.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' unleashes a runic blast in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and consumes all [[File:Overload 4.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' stacks.
params.description3: If '''Ryze''' consumed 2 stacks, he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
params.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} ''Overload'' deals {{pp|type=[[File:Realm Warp.png|20px|border]] ''Realm Warp's'' Rank|key=%|10 to 100 for 4|0 to 3}} {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} and spreads to surrounding ''Fluxed'' enemies.
params.notes:
* ''Overload'' can be buffered {{fd|0.5}} seconds before it comes off cooldown.
* ''Overload'' can be buffered while casting either {{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze}} or {{ai|Rune Prison|Ryze}} to cast immediately after the previous spell's cast time.
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets affected by {{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}

blurb.plain: Passive: Ryze other basic ability casts reset Overload's cooldown and generate a Rune stack, stacking up to 2 times.

blurb2.plain: Active: Ryze unleashes a runic bolt in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and consumes all Rune stacks.

blurb3.plain: If Ryze consumes the maximum Rune stacks, he gains bonus movement speed for a short time.

blurb4.plain: Flux Bonus: Overload deals increased damage and spreads to surrounding Flux enemies.

description.plain: Passive: Ryze's other basic ability casts reset Overload's cooldown and charge a Rune stack for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 2 times.

description2.plain: Active: Ryze unleashes a runic blast in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and consumes all Rune stacks.

description3.plain: If Ryze consumed 2 stacks, he gains bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

description4.plain: Flux Bonus: Overload deals 10% – 100% (based on Realm Warp's Rank) increased damage and spreads to surrounding Fluxed enemies.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ryze}} seizes the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|root|rooted}} instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' seizes the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|root|rooted}} instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.notes:
* ''Rune Prison'' can be buffered {{fd|0.5}} seconds before it comes off cooldown.

blurb.plain: Active: Ryze seizes the target enemy, dealing magic damage and briefly slowing them.

blurb4.plain: Flux Bonus: The target is rooted instead of slowed.

description.plain: Active: Ryze seizes the target enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing them by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

description2.plain: Flux Bonus: The target is rooted instead of slowed.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ryze}} projects an orb upon the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: The target and surrounding enemies are also marked with ''Flux'' for a short time. '''Ryze's''' basic abilities against ''Flux'' targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' projects an orb upon the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.

The target and surrounding enemies are also marked with ''Flux'' for 4 seconds. '''Ryze's''' basic abilities against ''Flux'' targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|4000|Initial orb missile speed}}|{{tt|1500|Spreading bounce missiles speed}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Spell Flux's'' second cast on a target will apply a new ''Flux'' debuff as well as triggering the previous one (effectively refreshing the duration).
* The {{tt|"main"|initial cast}} missile of ''Spell Flux'' is blocked by {{tip|projectile|projectile-intercepting}} effects, while the spreading bounce missiles are not.
* {{pending for test}} bounce range {{tip|er|icononly = true}} to-edge or {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} to-center?
** Game data notes additional range checks of 400 (bounce range) and 500 (Q damage bounce range) against 'large' enemies.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

blurb.plain: Active: Ryze projects an orb upon the target enemy that deals magic damage.

blurb2.plain: The target and surrounding enemies are also marked with Flux for a short time. Ryze's basic abilities against Flux targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.

blurb4.plain: Flux Bonus: Spell Flux spreads farther.

description.plain:
Active: Ryze projects an orb upon the target enemy that deals magic damage.
 The target and surrounding enemies are also marked with Flux for 4 seconds. Ryze's basic abilities against Flux targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.

description2.plain: Flux Bonus: Spell Flux spreads farther.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ryze}} {{tip|channel|channels}} for a short time to open a portal beneath him. '''Ryze''' can act during the channel, but the portal will cancel if he is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
params.blurb3: Upon completion, allies within the portal will {{tip|blink}} to the target location.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 2 seconds to open a portal beneath him, marking the target location as its destination and granting {{tip|sight}} of the target area. '''Ryze''' is able to act while channeling, but the portal will cancel if he is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
params.description3: Upon completion, '''Ryze''' and all allied units within the portal will {{tip|blink}} to the location and become {{tip|root|rooted}}, {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}, {{tip|silence|silenced}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.75}}|Estimated}} seconds.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|465|Portal radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|515|Destination area reveal radius during channel}}}}

blurb.plain: Passive: Overload Flux empowered damage is increased.

blurb2.plain: Active: Ryze channels for a short time to open a portal beneath him. Ryze can act during the channel, but the portal will cancel if he is interrupted.

blurb3.plain: Upon completion, allies within the portal will blink to the target location.

description.plain: Passive: Overload Flux empowered damage is increased.

description2.plain: Active: Ryze channels for 2 seconds to open a portal beneath him, marking the target location as its destination and granting sight of the target area. Ryze is able to act while channeling, but the portal will cancel if he is interrupted.

description3.plain: Upon completion, Ryze and all allied units within the portal will blink to the location and become rooted, disarmed, silenced and untargetable for 0.75 seconds.
